name: KGROUP
recent: KGROUP 于 2026 年 8 月 28 日召开第 23 届常年股东大会，所有决议均以投票方式通过。随后在 9 月 1 日及 10 月 17 日，公司先后公告 ENCIK AMIR AKRAM BIN ABDUL MUTALIB 与 ENCIK AHMAD RASYAD BIN ANWAR 在多个董事委员会中的职务变动。近期没有新闻报导。
notable: 第 23 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 8 月 28 日举行，所有决议均以投票方式通过。

recent_en: KGROUP held its 23rd Annual General Meeting on 28 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed by poll. Subsequently, on 1 September and 17 October, the company announced changes in several board committees involving ENCIK AMIR AKRAM BIN ABDUL MUTALIB and ENCIK AHMAD RASYAD BIN ANWAR. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: The 23rd Annual General Meeting was held on 28 August 2026, and all resolutions were passed by poll.
ENCIK AMIR AKRAM BIN ABDUL MUTALIB had changes in board and several committee roles on 1 September 2026.
ENCIK AHMAD RASYAD BIN ANWAR had changes in board and several committee roles on 17 October 2026.
